#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One new private source stage, then the reviewed owned-lifetime entry once."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import sys

ROOT = '/home/alex/work/pocket4-beike-owned-generation-20261106-b34f158f88bbebf112840fd88df25d03'
FILES = {'actual-probe.stdout.raw.jsonl': {'bytes': 14135, 'sha256': 'c590487759f7a0e2e32dec8cdb16a7c42b7f932ed88154f760fdde477770ef94'}, 'actual-probe.terminal.raw.json': {'bytes': 733, 'sha256': '86c28f1ff58512f7b8f3b42c59eb1a62e7bb20ce52edd0a043d54792e35d6762'}, 'generation-request.json': {'bytes': 1250, 'sha256': '70da4c77b0d7906c88da9e57afd95164654b7065dd89c9bf2baea8dfab5fdedd'}, 'prepare_beike_owned_lifetime.py': {'bytes': 20132, 'sha256': '76b858b83c7304287fedb13f80c889e3fa7a8d6d32d4183409a5ad6fce269baf'}}
STAT_KEYS = ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_mode", "st_uid", "st_gid", "st_nlink",
             "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns")


def require(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(code)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def write_new(directory, name, body):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                 0o600, dir_fd=directory)
    try:
        view = memoryview(body)
        while view:
            count = os.write(fd, view)
            require(count > 0, "WRITE_PROGRESS")
            view = view[count:]
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o400)
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.fsync(directory)


def readback(directory, name, expected):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=directory)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid == 0 and before.st_nlink == 1 and
                stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) == 0o400 and before.st_size == expected["bytes"],
                "NEW_PRIVATE_FILE_IDENTITY")
        raw = bytearray()
        while len(raw) <= expected["bytes"]:
            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, expected["bytes"] + 1 - len(raw)))
            if not part:
                break
            raw.extend(part)
        require(len(raw) == expected["bytes"] and sha(raw) == expected["sha256"], "STAGED_FILE_BYTES")
        again = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=directory)
        try:
            require(all(getattr(before, key) == getattr(os.fstat(fd), key) ==
                        getattr(os.fstat(again), key) for key in STAT_KEYS), "STAGED_FILE_REPLACED")
        finally:
            os.close(again)
        return bytes(raw)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def main():
    require(type(ROOT) is str and type(FILES) is dict, "UNSEALED_NO_STAGE")
    require(os.getuid() == os.geteuid() == 0, "ACTUAL_EXISTING_HOST_ROOT_REQUIRED")
    os.umask(0o077)
    before = len(os.listdir("/proc/self/fd"))
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read(262145)
    require(0 < len(raw) <= 262144, "CLOSED_STAGE_INPUT_BOUND")
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    require(set(payload) == {"schema", "files"} and
            payload["schema"] == "pocket4-beike-owned-generation-stage-input-v1" and
            type(payload["files"]) is list and len(payload["files"]) == len(FILES) == 4,
            "CLOSED_STAGE_PROTOCOL")
    bodies = {}
    for row in payload["files"]:
        require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"name", "text"} and
                row["name"] in FILES and row["name"] not in bodies and type(row["text"]) is str,
                "EXACT_FOUR_STAGE_MEMBERS")
        body = row["text"].encode("utf-8")
        require(len(body) == FILES[row["name"]]["bytes"] and
                sha(body) == FILES[row["name"]]["sha256"], "EXACT_REVIEWED_STAGE_BYTES")
        bodies[row["name"]] = body
    source_name = "prepare_beike_owned_lifetime.py"
    compile(bodies[source_name], ROOT + "/" + source_name, "exec")
    owned = []
    try:
        parent = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC)
        owned.append(parent)
        for name in ("home", "alex", "work"):
            parent = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            owned.append(parent)
        leaf = Path(ROOT).name
        os.mkdir(leaf, 0o700, dir_fd=parent)
        os.fsync(parent)
        directory = os.open(leaf, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
        owned.append(directory)
        root_stat = os.fstat(directory)
        require(root_stat.st_uid == 0 and stat.S_IMODE(root_stat.st_mode) == 0o700,
                "NEW_ROOT_PRIVATE_STAGE_REQUIRED")
        for name in sorted(FILES):
            write_new(directory, name, bodies[name])
            bodies[name] = readback(directory, name, FILES[name])
        again = os.open(leaf, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
        owned.append(again)
        require(all(getattr(root_stat, key) == getattr(os.fstat(again), key)
                    for key in ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_mode", "st_uid", "st_gid")), "STAGE_PATH_REPLACED")
    finally:
        failures = []
        for fd in reversed(owned):
            try:
                os.close(fd)
            except OSError:
                failures.append(fd)
        require(not failures, "BOOTSTRAP_FD_CLOSE_FAILED")
    require(len(os.listdir("/proc/self/fd")) == before, "BOOTSTRAP_FD_DIFFERENCE")
    print(json.dumps({"schema": "pocket4-beike-owned-generation-stage-v1", "stage_root": ROOT,
                      "files": FILES, "bootstrap_FDs_before": before, "bootstrap_FDs_after": before,
                      "Main_actions_before_worker": 0, "worker_not_yet_invoked": True,
                      "automatic_retry": False}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    path = ROOT + "/" + source_name
    self_pin = FILES[source_name]
    sys.argv = [path, "--execute-new-source-preparation", "--source-sha256", self_pin["sha256"],
                "--source-bytes", str(self_pin["bytes"])]
    exec(compile(bodies[source_name], path, "exec"), {"__name__": "__main__", "__file__": path})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
